title: Brick 솔로 #026 · hourglass bombshell · 터키석 단색 블록 · 팔짱 · 무도회장 · 비닐 블랙립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, voluminous curls jet-black hair — full body single-colour interlocking plastic toy-brick sculpture fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid toy-brick body built from thousands of small interlocking glossy plastic bricks stacked in staggered rows, the bricks stepping in tiny stair-like layers along her curves so the whole figure still follows her body's true three-dimensional shape, a regular grid of round cylindrical studs clearly visible on every upward-facing brick surface, thin dark seams between every brick, nothing lying flat. Dense brick surface — BLAZING glossy turquoise-blue bricks across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID a scattering of pure white bricks forming bold stripes along her sides, and glossy highlights catching on every round stud, glossy hard plastic, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing tall, arms crossed under her bust, chin raised, looking down at the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same plastic toy bricks, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same plastic toy bricks with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the brick figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look black gradient eyeshadow with a chrome highlight on the lids, a graphic black liner, sleek lashes, high-shine black vinyl lips like polished glass, a cool matte contour.

Background: a bright grand ballroom with a polished parquet floor, tall mirrors, standard-height double doors and a low stage step, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
